about_the_game:
Step into a narrative-driven experience where nothing is as it seems.
A quiet town, days that repeat, and a routine that slowly begins to crack. What first feels ordinary soon turns into a disturbing chain of events that will challenge your perception of reality.

This is not a game of traditional heroes or epic battles. Here, the struggle is internal, and every choice you make will bring you closer to hidden truths… or to more questions.

Explore detailed environments, talk to characters whose stories shift based on your actions, and uncover hidden fragments that reveal what lies beneath the surface.
Time plays a crucial role: each day introduces variations, new clues, and the consequences of your previous decisions.

content_descriptors.notes: It addresses topics such as depression, anxiety, drugs, addiction, mental disorders, and what could happen if they cannot be properly controlled.
